title: Music Similarity Estimation from Jukebox Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.34346v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Content-based music similarity estimation aims to provide a measure of similarity between music audio recordings, disregarding any associated metadata. This has potential applications in e.g. cold-start music recommendation scenarios, where there is no user interaction data. In this work, we propose JukeSim, a new approach to estimating musical similarity based on embeddings created by Jukebox, a generative music model. In evaluations on multiple datasets, we find that JukeSim performs on par with an existing learning-based approach, and both outperform the best hand-designed approaches, which had never been compared to recent work before. Even though the required compute for JukeSim is higher than for other measures, we demonstrate the viability of utilizing generative embeddings for this task, encouraging further research.

translated_title: 基于Jukebox嵌入的音乐相似度估计
translated_abstract: 基于内容的音乐相似度估计旨在提供一种衡量音乐录音之间相似度的方法，而不依赖任何相关的元数据。这在冷启动音乐推荐等场景中具有潜在应用价值，因为此类场景中缺乏用户交互数据。在这项工作中，我们提出了JukeSim，一种基于生成式音乐模型Jukebox所创建的嵌入来估计音乐相似度的新方法。在多个数据集上的评估中，我们发现JukeSim的表现与现有的基于学习的方法相当，且两者均优于最佳的手工设计方法——这些手工设计方法此前从未与近期工作进行过比较。尽管JukeSim所需的计算量高于其他度量方法，但我们证明了利用生成式嵌入完成这一任务的可行性，这将鼓励进一步的研究。
tldr: 提出JukeSim方法，首次利用生成式音乐模型Jukebox的嵌入来估计音乐相似度，其性能与基于学习的方法相当，并优于最佳的手工设计方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes JukeSim, a novel approach that estimates music similarity using embeddings from the generative music model Jukebox, performing on par with learning-based methods and outperforming the best hand-designed approaches.
